alive.last_commit_message:
fix(docker): copy README_ZH.md from readme/ after docs reorg (#822)

README_ZH.md was moved from the repo root to readme/README_ZH.md in
e08175b8 (multilingual README reorganization), but docker.sh still
copied it from the root. With set -e the one-click deploy script
aborted at the copy stage, leaving an incomplete release-package/
directory.

Update the copy path to readme/README_ZH.md and note the migration.

Verified by running the copy stage against a fresh depth-1 clone:
all 8 expected entries (docker-compose.yml, README.md, README_ZH.md,
CHANGELOG.md, data, db, logs, uploads) now land in release-package/.

Fixes #821

Co-authored-by: aigsec <aigsec@tencent.com>
